newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Treasury corrects 1-yr bills allotment.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Treasury corrects 1-yr bills allotment.

text.p: The Spanish Treasury said on Tuesday it was correcting the amount bid and the allotment on its one-year bill sold at the auction on Monday.

The Treasury informed, as reported on Reuter page KSPL, that bids for one-year bills were 295.24 billion pesetas instead of 310.23 billion pesetas, and those allotted were 150.02 billion pesetas instead of 165.01 billion.
The Treasury explained that the change was due to human error by one of the financial entities bidding.
Marginal and average price remain unchanged.
